plainTranslation: The Mars person moves toward what the Venus person naturally attracts. Chemistry is immediate, physical, and hard to ignore. The risk is mistaking pursuit for compatibility, so check whether affection, repair, and basic respect exist after the heat settles.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryShort: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper sit right on top of your affections, tastes, and sense of worth.
summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper sit right on top of your affections, tastes, and sense of worth. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: Failure mode: mistaking wanting someone for actually being compatible with them. Things can burn hot and fast, then you realize there may not be much holding it together once the charge settles.
advice: Let the spark introduce you. Then take a minute and see if you actually like each other.
